messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- Age dawned amidst thunderous skies and iron-forged thrones
- Men waged holy wars across deserts and seas
- Cities crumbled beneath weighty burdens of greed
- Hope flickered through shadowed valleys with fragile light
- Prophets spoke in tongues of fire and stone
- Kings rose, then fell like autumn leaves
